boundaryGate.question: After accepted AlembicPlugin commit bdd0b62, does the real BiliDili P10 project-index workflow keep coverage ledger module axes target-scoped through host bootstrap/rescan and produce an empty normalized host-vs-in-process parity diff?
boundaryGate.objectBoundary: Real BiliDili workspace P10 project-index workflow parity only: host route bootstrap/dimension-completion/rescan/noPadding cleanup plus in-process route with moduleScope=["BiliDili"].
controllerSelfChecks: Controller accepted AlembicPlugin source repair bdd0b62 only after raw diff review and replayed unit tests/build/biome/diff whitespace.
Plugin repair covers dimension-completion writes, rescan seed writes, coverage advisory filtering, and ModuleService target-axis fallback.
P10 has not been accepted; real BiliDili rerun is required before P10 can advance.
realScenarioConditions: Use the real BiliDili workspace directly, not a sandbox copy.
Use configured providers: DeepSeek generation and local Qwen/Ollama embedding.
Record repository pins before run: AlembicPlugin bdd0b62, AlembicCore 99a7cf10, current Alembic/AlembicWorkspace pins, and BiliDili HEAD.
Use alembic_bootstrap{rebuild:true} reset between runs as required by the state root.
Capture before-host, after-host-bootstrap-complete, after-host-rescan, after-host-nopadding-cleanup, and in-process snapshots.
successMeans: Host coverage ledger is non-empty and targetScopedOnly=true after bootstrap and after rescan.
Host coverage advisory does not surface BiliDili, Sources, Packages/*, root, or module:root:* when target cells exist.
noPadding cleanup leaves active sessions and open rounds clear.
In-process moduleScope=["BiliDili"] keeps nested ProjectMap target modules and writes a non-empty ledger.
Normalized host vs in-process parity diff is empty and not a 0-vs-0 comparison.
failureMeans: Any aggregate/root module id is written or surfaced in host coverage ledger/advisory after target cells exist.
Host or in-process coverage ledger is empty in a way that makes parity 0-vs-0.
R-2 proof fails, providers are wrong, reset is unsafe, noPadding cleanup regresses, or in-process collapses to root/aggregate axes.
Required raw snapshots/log summaries are missing.
cannotConclude: Cannot conclude demand complete, P10 accepted, G4/G6 passed, or P11/P12/P13 ready solely from this card.
Cannot treat non-empty mixed-axis ledger as success.
Cannot treat a manual DB cleanup as valid evidence.
stopConditions: Stop and backfill blocked if repository identity, state root, BiliDili path, provider routing, or reset safety is inconsistent.
Stop at the first hard raw blocker and preserve evidence; do not continue into unrelated phases.
Stop if running the real workspace would require manual DB/source/provider mutation.

evidenceRequired: Raw snapshots before host, after bootstrap, after rescan, after noPadding cleanup, and after in-process route.
Coverage ledger/advisory module id summaries with targetScopedOnly predicate.
Normalized host/in-process parity report and diff.
Log summary for noPadding cleanup and coverageLedgerSeed.
allowedOperations: Run real BiliDili workflow probes required for P10 parity evidence.
Run alembic_bootstrap with rebuild:true for reset between runs.
Read runtime DB/log JSON and produce bounded snapshots/summaries.
Return blocked with first raw blocker if any predicate fails.
forbiddenOperations: Do not manually edit BiliDili source, DB, sessions, provider config, package versions, coverage ledger rows, or repository source code.
Do not repair Alembic/AlembicPlugin/AlembicCore source from Test.
Do not create a sandbox copy for this task.
Do not accept P10 or any later phase from Test.
